Kimberly / Grace — next steps to get StrataVox live in Redwood's vendor registry:

2) Completed vendor data form (I attached our template). Please return with the tax ID/VAT number and bank instructions for SEPA/ACH.

A few clarifications for routing: if StrataVox will invoice in EUR we will map you to our EU legal entity and route payments via SEPA; if invoices come in USD we route to our US payables lane and may require a W-8/W-9 depending on tax treatment.

Liam — I'll send the DocuSign and the vendor data template now (attached). If you can return the completed template and signed DocuSign by Friday (23 Apr) we can target vendor activation the following week.

Thanks,
